mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 68 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, with an air quality index of 51, which is in the moderate range.

In city news, the I Voted sticker design contest for students is moving forward, with public voting set for July 28 through August 7. Also, a reminder from Public Works to inspect your mailboxes for winter durability and follow the guidelines on the city website to avoid damage from snow removal equipment.

We have a busy couple of days! Today, check out the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. On July 27, join a yoga session at Insight Wellness, and then on July 28, test your knowledge at Trivia nights at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.
Your flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
